meeting-notes-template.15: Google Docs' meeting notes block can pull the event title, date and attendees from Google Calendar automatically. In Notion, a database of meeting notes lets you filter by project or person later, and for Word agendas there is our [meeting agenda template in Word](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-agenda-template-word).
meeting-notes-template.18: Use a template when meetings are short, you are comfortable typing while listening, or you cannot record. When meetings are long, when you need to participate fully, or when you meet in several languages, use an AI note taker instead.
